citation.holdings: BIS/11/803, WERS6 Management Questionnaire (MQ), Section C and the EPQ items it depends on (GOV.UK)

stdyInfo.abstract: This study contains Section C (recruitment, training and organisation of work) of the management interview of the sixth Workplace Employment Relations Study (WERS 2011), a CAPI interview with the most senior manager responsible for staff and employment relations at British workplaces, plus the employee-profile items it builds on (number of employees, occupational structure). The manager reports how vacancies are filled and which recruitment criteria, tests and channels are used, and, for the largest non-managerial occupational group, induction, the share given off-the-job training, training days and training content, multi-skilling, job autonomy and teamworking. A last item asks for the share of all employees using computers.

sumDscr.universe: Workplaces in Great Britain with at least 5 employees; respondent: the most senior manager responsible for staff and employment relations at the workplace. Most of Section C refers to the largest non-managerial occupational group of the workplace.
